They also emphasized the importance of product differentiation against competitors like Posthog, focusing on feature flagging strength and integration with AI tools. Marketing resources are stretched thin, necessitating focused support for AI outreach and efficient event lead follow-up.

calls.summary:
# Marketing + Sales Sync
Date: 2026-08-31 | Duration: 31m

## Summary
The team focused on improving coordination between sales and marketing through cleaner HubSpot data, clearer ownership, and better workflow alignment. OP Methods’ scope includes lifecycle cleanup, lead scoring, duplicate removal, customer tagging, workflows, and reporting integration, while Jeff’s work centers more on pipeline analysis and sales methodology. Leadership also considered a full-time RevOps or Marketing Ops hire to reduce fragmented consulting efforts. Jake will focus on SMB deals through a round-robin model, with coaching and data-driven prioritization. Inbound marketing generates most of his meetings, while cold outreach has produced limited responses, including some sequences with 0% reply rates. Warm campaign leads require next-day follow-up, after a delayed response to Philadelphia Inquirer webinar leads. Marketing-supported sequences should replace less effective custom sequences. Jake H.’s dinner registrations are performing strongly, but attendance will depend on registration volume because hotels can cost upwards of $600 per night. LinkedIn activity is being connected to HubSpot to improve visibility, accountability, coaching, and follow-up measurement. Lyndsie will organize a role-alignment call with Jeff and OP Methods.

## Keywords
HubSpot, OP Methods, lead scoring, sales and marketing alignment, SMB deals, outreach campaigns

## Action Items

**Lyndsie Berens**
Share outreach and campaign response data with Ryan McGurk for review to support analysis and prioritization (16:09)
Set up an alignment call with Jeff and OP Methods involving Ryan McGurk and Ashley Stirrup to clarify roles and responsibilities on HubSpot lifecycle and data management (20:31)
Confirm whether Jake has connected LinkedIn outreach data with HubSpot to enable tracking of InMails and messages (17:43)

**Ryan McGurk**
Join the alignment call with OP Methods, Jeff, Lyndsie Berens, and Ashley Stirrup to clarify scopes and workflows related to HubSpot lifecycle and data hygiene (03:48)
Review the shared campaign and outreach data, then formulate a game plan with Jake to prioritize time and improve sequence usage for better engagement (16:11)
Engage with the sales team to discuss dinner attendance incentives and expense management to optimize pipeline-building events (20:05)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Support coordination of the upcoming alignment call with OP Methods and sales leadership to ensure smooth scheduling and agenda setting (04:42)
Monitor and share feedback on Jake’s campaign follow-ups and sequence adoption to improve execution and engagement rates (11:15)
